To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
there exist few approaches to evaluate educational games.

(1) There are few approaches to systematically evaluating educational games; (2) Most approaches are developed in a ad-hoc manner and do not follow any explicit definition of the evaluation study, its execution, data collection instruments or data analysis methods; (3) There is no clear pattern on which quality factors of educational games to evaluate; (4) The majority of the studies focus on the evaluation of the learning impact of educational games.
